_comment: Curated Mixkit SFX for the 9:16 edit grammar. Pick by ROLE, not by title — see fetch_sfx.py docstring. Run `python3 fetch_sfx.py sync` to materialise the audio and regenerate manifest.json. Ids are Mixkit sound ids; `name` is optional display text used in the filename.
notes: Starter pack: impacts land the opening beat, whooshes carry segment-to-segment transitions, fail/win bookend comedy and payoff moments. Keep files short — anything over ~3s fights a 15-25s cut.
